about: One logical set of coding abilities for Act. Each device runs only what it can; the model is given only the tools of the device doing the work, so it never calls one that is not there. Kept identical in mobile-wiqo and desktop-wiqo.

file_read_write.mobile: writer returns full changed files; editor saves by hand

project_search.mobile: project search in the code tab

symbol_dependency.desktop: repo_map file: symbols, imports, dependents up to 3 levels
symbol_dependency.mobile: select(): symbols + one import hop, picks <=40 files for the writer

apply_patch.mobile: writer patch blocks, applied on the device copy

diff_snapshot_restore.mobile: history entries with before/after; undo and restore to a version

version_guard.desktop: FILE_CHANGED / FILE_NOT_READ: no write over a file changed since the agent read it
version_guard.mobile: sealed sync baseVersion + conflict copies; GitHub pull keeps both sides as '… - GitHub kopyası'

git.desktop: git through shell; push/reset/clean always asked
git.mobile: POST /code-sync/git/import|pull|push via the person's GitHub account; push only to a non-default branch, after a yes, refused on upstream overlap

build_lint_test.mobile: not available; JSON and plain JS syntax checked on the device, everything else reported as unchecked; 'Mac'te derle/test et' hands it to the PC

user_api.desktop: api tool → POST /agent/api (list, describe, call; writes asked on the PC)
user_api.mobile: Uygulamalar → Kendi sunucun: add (key sealed on the server), test, OpenAPI import; chat uses user_api (writes go through the confirmation card)

web_research.mobile: chat research tools; Act pages may GET public keyless APIs listed in act.network.json

verification_report.desktop: ledger.rs: answer ends with Yapıldı / Doğrulandı / Doğrulanmadı from real exit codes; one turn-back when files changed and nothing checked them
verification_report.mobile: history entry verified flag + 'Derlenmedi ve test edilmedi' note; server/database work goes to a Node project for the PC

privacy: Code from a GitHub repository passes through the server only on its way between GitHub and the phone and is never stored; a device-only project never syncs; nothing from a private repository reaches Missions or Keşfet unless the person shares it.
